index.lead: Connected judges, their load and status. An auth key is shown once, when a judge is created or its key is rotated.

notes.load: Load is the mean the judges report; online status refreshes when the page reloads.
notes.rotate: Rotating a key disconnects the judge at once; blocking a judge also disconnects it.

row.started: Started {time} · ping is the mean of the last 6 measurements.

block.title: Block {name}?
block.body: A connected judge is disconnected and cannot reconnect until it is unblocked.

rotate.title: Issue a new key for {name}?
rotate.body: The judge is disconnected at once and needs the new key to reconnect.

disconnect.title: Disconnect {name}?
disconnect.body: The judge reconnects by itself unless it is blocked. To stop it for good, block it.
disconnect.force: Disconnect now, without waiting for running submissions

key.warning: The auth key is shown only once — the system stores only a hash of it. Copy the key into the judge's configuration before closing.
key.label: Auth key

add.title: Create judge
add.nameLabel: Judge name (matches the id the judge connects with)
add.nameHint: Letters, digits, “_”, “.” or “-” only (up to 50 characters).
add.nameInvalid: Letters, digits, “_”, “.” or “-” only (up to 50 characters).
add.nameTaken: That judge name is already in use.

delete.title: Delete judge {name}?
delete.body: The disconnected judge and its key are removed from the list. Submissions waiting for this judge alone move to other judges.

alerts.noJudge: {count} {subject} submissions are waiting but no online judge runs that language.
alerts.pinnedOffline: {count} submissions are waiting for judge {subject} alone, which is not working.
alerts.stale: The oldest waiting submission has waited over 5 minutes: the queue may be stuck.
